# NFL Daily — 2026-08-28 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/28: NFL teams began trimming rosters to the 53-man limit, with the cutdown deadline moved to Sunday 6 p.m. ET for the first time in 22 years, to accommodate the Rams-49ers trip to Australia. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/why-nfls-2026-cut-deadline-is-being-held-on-a-sunday-for-the-first-time-in-22-years/)
- 08/27: Browns named Deshaun Watson their starting QB over Shedeur Sanders, and league sources now question whether Sanders has a starting future in Cleveland. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/shedeur-sanders-future-browns-qb-job-deshaun-watson/)
- 08/28: Patriots traded WR Kayshon Boutte to the Texans, who plugged him into a receiver room banged up by injuries. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/kayshon-boutte-trade-analysis-patriots-texans/)
- 08/28: Rams acquired WR Tutu Atwell for receiver depth; coach Sean McVay denied it's related to a possible Puka Nacua suspension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49750040/atwell-trade-depth-not-possible-nacua-ban)
- 08/28: Packers RB Josh Jacobs was formally charged with two misdemeanors — battery and criminal damage to property — stemming from a May arrest; the NFL is reviewing possible discipline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49745245/packers-star-rb-josh-jacobs-charged-two-misdemeanors)
- 08/28: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak still won't name a Week 1 starting QB, but all signs continue to point to Kirk Cousins over Fernando Mendoza. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/raiders-klint-kubiak-still-wont-name-week-1-qb-starter-kirk-cousins/)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-08-28 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/28: Only two or three roster spots remain genuinely up for grabs, per Zrebiec — names like Adisa Isaac, Ethan Burke, Robert Longerbeam, Rasheen Ali and Adam Randall are under the microscope ahead of Sunday's cutdown. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2093423971836248413)
- 08/28: Ravens aren't inclined to carry a third QB, but UDFA Joe Fagnano has made a strong enough case that Baltimore may have doubts he'd clear waivers. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2093423032903557288)
- 08/28: HC Jesse Minter said even fewer players will play in Friday's finale than in the first two preseason games, with the Jovaughn Gwyn-Ethan Pocic center competition among the things to watch. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2093422192788639808)
- 08/28: Ravens gained expanded marketing access to Montgomery and Prince George's counties — traditionally "Commanders Country" — after an NFL rule change. [Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-commanders-home-marketing-areas-montgomery-prince-georges-ZXJ4EBDV3RG5NJKL4T6QHV3PW4/)
